verses.text: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.
Suddenly there was a powerful earthquake. An angel of the Lord came down from heaven, went to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.
He shone like lightning, and his clothes were as white as snow.
The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.
The angel said to the women, "Do not be afraid. I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was nailed to the cross.
He is not here! He has risen, just as he said he would. Come and see the place where the Lord lay.
Then go quickly and tell his followers, 'He has risen from the dead. He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.' Now I have told you."
So the women hurried away from the tomb. They were afraid, but they were filled with great joy. They ran to tell his followers.
Suddenly Jesus met them. "Greetings," he said. They came to him, took hold of his feet and worshipped him.
Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see me."
While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city. They told the chief priests everything that had happened.
The chief priests met with the elders and made a plan. They gave the soldiers a large amount of money.
They told them, "You must say, 'His followers came during the night and stole his body while we were sleeping.'
If the governor hears about this, we will talk to him and keep you out of trouble."
So the soldiers took the money and did as they were told. And this story has been spread among the Jewish people to this very day.
Then the eleven followers went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.
When they saw him, they worshipped him, but some still had doubts.
Then Jesus came to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
So go and make followers of all nations. Baptise them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.
Teach them to obey everything I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the very end of the world." Amen.
